name: Mt. Diablo Zen Group
reason: Too thin: mtdiablozen.com (read 13 Nov 2026) is a small WordPress site for one weekly Wednesday sitting group led by John Busch (alternating in person and on Zoom); its 2026 calendar page holds that programme plus a Saturday sitting on 14 Nov (not after 14 Nov), and the only other page is a reading list. That gives fewer than about 3 distinct items with their own URLs, no YouTube channel, and no photo of the zendo larger than 240 px. Contact (mtdiablozen@gmail.com) is published.
